name: Jane, Turns Of Life
source:
You play as Jane, a novice in her way to became closing nun. Jane Is not 100% sure with his actual life. Now you have to take her decisions...Do you want to make her continue with her monastic life or do you want to turn her into another type of person? Do you want to make her a slut?

[From [url=https://deephole.itch.io/jane-turns-of-life]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你将扮演简，一名正准备成为隐修修女的初学修女。简对自己目前的人生并非完全笃定。现在，你要替她做出决定…你想让她继续修道生活，还是变成另一种人？你想让她成为一个放荡的女人吗？

[摘自[url=https://deephole.itch.io/jane-turns-of-life]itch.io[/url]]
